jokes.label: Joke A
jokes.title: Back Road Bravery
jokes.joke: I was driving down a country road at night when my GPS said, "Turn left," and the only thing on the left was a cornfield. Then the radio whispered my name. I tried to stay calm, but when a scarecrow moved, I didn’t investigate the paranormal—I became paranormal. I left my body at 55 and my dignity at the next mailbox.

jokes.label: Joke B
jokes.title: Ghost Hunter's Confidence
jokes.joke: I dated a paranormal investigator for a while. Guy walks into haunted houses with night vision goggles and an EMF meter, screaming 'SHOW YOURSELF, COWARD' at empty hallways. Total tough guy. Then one night the floorboard creaked and he grabbed my hand so hard I thought he was gonna propose. I said, 'I thought you weren't afraid of ghosts.' He said, 'I'm not afraid of ghosts. I'm afraid of getting murdered by one.' Bro, that's the same thing. He goes, 'No, one's a career, the other's Tuesday.'

jokes.label: Joke C
jokes.title: Rugged Chassis
jokes.joke: I finally started seeing a therapist, which is tough when you're raised to be super macho. In our first session, she asked me to describe my feelings. I didn't have the emotional vocabulary, so I panicked and described a truck commercial. I squinted, lowered my voice, and said, 'Doc, I'm hauling a heavy payload on a rugged, steel-reinforced chassis.' She just nodded and diagnosed me with a Ford F-150.

jokes.label: Joke D
jokes.title: Macho Meltdown
jokes.joke: Folks, I’ve always played the macho guy—big truck, beard, fixing stuff with my bare hands like it’s nothing. But lately I’ve been experiencing a crisis of self-doubt. Am I really that tough? So I grabbed an axe, headed to the backyard to chop wood and prove it. First swing, I missed the log, nailed my foot. Now I’m in the ER yelling at the nurse, 'This doesn’t count—I’m still macho!' She just patted my hand and said, 'Sure, big guy.'

jokes.label: Joke E
jokes.title: Macho Ghost
jokes.joke: I tried to act all macho when I thought my house was haunted. I marched right into the living room like, 'If there’s a ghost in here, show yourself!' And the lights flickered, the floor creaked, and I immediately yelled, 'Okay, you showed yourself! Great job! I’m leaving now!'
